messages:
maria: Quick copy sprint — we need a concise pass for three pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) before Monday. Focus: conversion clarity, one micro-benchmark each, webinar CTA routing, inbound form mapping. :calendar:
jon: Got it. What exact metrics should the micro-benchmarks highlight? latency / cost / uptime?
kevin: Suggested: Hosted -> latency and $/1k tokens; Dedicated -> sustained throughput & autoscale behavior; Private -> compliance + audit/KMS details. Also call out compatible model families & quantization options.
ashley: Drafting hero lines. Two quick variants: A) "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, private." B) "Ship LLM features with production SLAs and flexible deployment." Thoughts?
maria: Prefer B but trim: "Ship LLM features with production SLAs and flexible deployment options." Clear and concise.
jon: For webinar CTA: "Join our launch webinar — live demos of Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments + benchmark walkthroughs." Use that on the pages and the blog post.
kevin: Inbound routing logic — we should fast-path high-value leads to SDRs and keep self-serve for small teams. Snippet below for ops to implement:
```
/submit-demo form:
- tier=enterprise -> route: sdr@redwood.ai; lead_score += 20
- tier=midmarket -> route: eco-team@redwood.ai; lead_score += 10
- uses_private=true -> add_tag: "private-deploy"
- wants_webinar=true -> set_campaign: "launch-webinar"
```
ashley: Hero micro-benchmarks (short bullets we can put under hero or in a small row): Hosted ~50ms median per-token (small open model), Dedicated ~5k tokens/s sustained throughput on reserved pool, Private: audit logs + KMS + optional air-gapped deploy. Keep them descriptive, not too many decimals. :eyes:
jon: Copy bullets for benefits: "Unified API across hosted, dedicated, and private", "Predictable unit economics", "Enterprise controls & auditability" — short, active voice.
maria: Add a trust line under Private: "SOC 2, customer-managed VPC, optional on-prem package". Also add a short sentence linking to docs for rollout/rollbacks.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar registration page goes live Tue 09:00 PT — @ashley please finalize CTA variants by Mon 17:00.
kevin: I'll assemble a one-pager benchmark PDF for each mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with methodology notes and sample prompts. Will share links here when ready.
ashley: I'll push copy variants to the Website Copy doc and add a short QA checklist (headlines, subhead, 3 bullets, CTA + routing tag). Ping me for edits.
maria: Solid. Next check-in Mon 10:30 PT to finalize. If anyone needs to escalate earlier DM me. :rocket:
